reviewed_checks: All 41 implementation and metadata SHA-256 bindings match. The project manifest contains exactly one delayed experiment registration.

Twelve frozen distinct fast-machine pairs define mass-centered unit-spread directions. The independent NumPy generator integrates all 72 prescribed trials at both steps and selects the first qualifying speed per slot using truth only. Qualifying unstable truth has identical first confirmation indices at both steps, confirmation 0.20 to 0.80 seconds after forecast origin and first-window signed margin in [0.0001, 0.05]. Stable truth settles over the full eight-second scoring horizon. Missing qualified slots terminate the scope without replacement or retuning.

Train-only normalization and initial calibration use the complete twelve-event train roster. Unstable supervision ends at its exact first five-point confirmation; stable supervision ends at three seconds. The observed eleven-point history and future-containing windows align with the frozen physical rule in radians and rad/s.

The shared initial stiffness factor 1.15, damping factor 1.35, ten ports 0.55 and prescribed time constants are frozen. Five Gauss-Newton iterations estimate each history hidden state with memory radius 1 and prior weight 0; these are distinct from the twenty Adam shared-parameter updates per fit.

Two full-train gradients at the common start determine the single fixed norm-ratio coefficient. Finite nonzero gradient norms, at least two missed train witnesses and at least five percent change in the clipped first-Adam direction are eligibility conditions. Failing calibration freezes and evaluates only the initial model. There is no coefficient search, intermediate val selection or test-based model adjustment.

The candidate retains the registered val margin, matched-trigger, full-coverage, zero-false-alarm and pooled three/eight-second trajectory guards. The added train recovery gate requires both models to have qualified == allocated == truth_triggers == 6 before requiring one additional predicted train witness; missing results cannot count as recovered misses.

Two calibration gradients plus forty training gradients and three energy checks total the registered maximum of 45. Worst-case one-time event isolation remains covered by 1337 rollouts, 3214083 Torch RHS, 196400 tangent RHS and 3900 of each solve operation.
